  15theorem v1_0x0_1x0_2x1_4x2 : val 1 {(0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 1), (4, 2)} = (3 / 2 : ℚ) := by
  16  have hmin : ∀ d ∈ ({(0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 1), (4, 2)} : Multiset Cat), 1 ≤ d.2 → finisher (2, 1) ≤ finisher d := by
  17    intro d hd hd1
  18    simp only [Multiset.insert_eq_cons, Multiset.mem_cons, Multiset.mem_singleton] at hd
  19    rcases hd with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> (try norm_num at hd1) <;> (try norm_num)
  20  rw [val_one_eq _ (by decide) (2, 1) (by decide) (by decide) hmin] <;> norm_num
